name: Red
source:
The second best maid around, both in fighting and servitude. She is feisty and nasty, teasing your maid with direct insults and intended low hits. However, she is completely obedient to her mistress, dropping the feisty act with a simple demand. She truly does care for her mistress beyond anything else.

[From [url=http://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/maid-with-perfection]official site[/url]]
